description: List geofences: circular places (stores, venues) the Sequenzy mobile SDKs watch. Signed-in app users entering, leaving or staying in one record app.geofence_entered, app.geofence_exited and app.geofence_dwelled events with geofenceId, geofenceName, geofenceGroup and geofenceExternalId properties, usable as sequence triggers (event trigger with propertyFilters) and in segments (field geofence). Paged by cursor.
